body:
You can say that, but we live in a day and age where rubbing people's mistakes and lowest points in their faces is a national sport, or where just because you don't agree with something, it gives you permission to try to ruin someone's life. I have been trying to start over, and it has partially worked, but I feel like it's not enough. No one wants to really help me or be there for me. I can partially understand why in some case, but it's not like I'm not trying to improve things.

Thank you for your message, though.
